JS Image Grid

A vanilla JavaScript library for overlaying resizable grids on images

How to use

  • Click and drag the grid overlay to reposition it
  • Use the corner and edge handles to resize the grid
  • Each image can have different grid configurations
  • The grid maintains its column and row count whilst resizing

Examples

Default grid (12x12)

Basic grid with 12 columns and 12 rows using default settings

<img src="image.jpg" data-js-image-grid-cols="12" data-js-image-grid-rows="12">

Custom grid with blue lines

16 columns, 10 rows with custom blue colour

<img src="image.jpg" data-js-image-grid-cols="16" data-js-image-grid-rows="10" data-js-image-grid-color="#0000ff">

Thick green grid lines

8 columns, 8 rows with thick green lines

<img src="image.jpg" data-js-image-grid-cols="8" data-js-image-grid-rows="8" data-js-image-grid-line-width="3" data-js-image-grid-color="#00ff00">

Fine grid with orange lines

20 columns, 15 rows with custom orange colour

<img src="image.jpg" data-js-image-grid-cols="20" data-js-image-grid-rows="15" data-js-image-grid-color="#ff6600">

Aspect ratio maintained

Grid with aspect ratio locked when resizing

<img src="image.jpg" data-js-image-grid-cols="12" data-js-image-grid-rows="8" data-js-image-grid-maintain-aspect-ratio="true" data-js-image-grid-color="#ff00ff">

Multiple grids on one image

Add multiple grids to the same image and switch between them. A grid picker appears automatically when you add a second grid. Click the "+ Add New Grid" button or use the button below to create additional grids.

const manager = ImageGrid.getGridManager(imageElement); manager.addNewGrid();

Installation

Include the CSS and JavaScript files in your HTML:

<link rel="stylesheet" href="js-image-grid.css"> <script src="js-image-grid.min.js"></script>

See README.md for full documentation and configuration options.
